one_line: A young Kamarupa boundary scout from the Brahmaputra valley, embodying the river communities’ adaptive knowledge and governance of a living floodplain.

appearance.age_look: Early 20s, lean but sturdy build, used to walking long distances on soft, wet ground.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, slightly sun-tanned; straight nose, full lips, and large expressive dark-brown eyes with a focused, observant gaze; a faint horizontal scar on the left cheek; default expression calm, alert and quietly determined.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled into a high, tight topknot (almost bun-like) at the back of the crown, sides smoothed with oil; a narrow off-white cloth headband tied around the forehead with the knot at the back, ends short so they don’t flap in wind.
appearance.costume: Simple but neat floodplain attire: a knee-length, side-slit cotton tunic (kurta-like) in dull river-olive green with long, close-fitting sleeves and a narrow round neck; beneath, a full-length off-white cotton dhoti wrapped securely and pleated to mid-calf for wading, with a thin dark-brown woven border; a light, undyed cotton gamcha-style scarf with fine red checks draped from the left shoulder across the chest and tied at the right hip, ends hanging to mid-thigh; on his feet, simple dark-brown leather sandals with toe loop and ankle strap, straps slightly stained from mud; a narrow braided cane belt at the waist holding a small cloth pouch and a rolled palm-leaf; minimal jewellery: a single small bronze earring in the left ear and a thin, plain bronze bangle on the right wrist; fabrics look handwoven, slightly textured, without ostentatious patterning.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly weathered bamboo staff about his own height, with knots visible, its top wrapped in dark-brown cord to form a grip and a small tied bundle of palm-leaf boundary records just below the grip; the lower end is darkened and smoothed from use in probing soft riverbeds and marking boundary points.

ref_desc: A lean, sun-tanned young Kamarupa scout with an oval face, high black hair topknot and off-white headband, wearing a river-olive tunic over off-white dhoti, red-checked gamcha scarf, leather sandals, minimal bronze jewellery, and carrying a bamboo staff wrapped with palm-leaf records in muddy earth tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style reference of a young male Kamarupa boundary scout from the Brahmaputra valley: lean and sturdy, medium-brown sun-tanned skin, oval face with large dark-brown eyes, calm and alert, a faint scar on his left cheek; his thick black hair is pulled into a high tight topknot, with a narrow off-white cloth headband around his forehead. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved cotton tunic in dull river-olive green over an off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to mid-calf, the dhoti having a thin dark-brown woven border; a light off-white gamcha-style scarf with fine red checks is draped from his left shoulder across the chest and tied at the right hip, ends hanging to mid-thigh. His feet have simple dark-brown leather sandals with toe loop and ankle straps, lightly stained from mud; a narrow braided cane belt holds a small cloth pouch and a rolled palm-leaf. He has a single small bronze earring in his left ear and a thin bronze bangle on his right wrist. In his right hand he holds a long bamboo staff about his height, with its top wrapped in dark-brown cord as a grip and a small bundle of tied palm-leaf boundary records just below the grip, the lower end of the staff darkened and smoothed from probing wet ground. Use a palette of river-olive green, off-white, dark brown, muted red, and bronze, and show him in a neutral stance as a clean, clear model sheet with head-to-toe visibility and consistent details.
